summary.text: Frances Cavenaugh represents District 30 in the Arkansas House of Representatives, which includes parts of Lawrence, Craighead and Greene counties, and has served in the House since 2017.

paragraphs.text: Cavenaugh is chief financial officer of Cavenaugh Auto Group in Walnut Ridge and a past president of the Arkansas Independent Automobile Dealers Association.
She is president of The Children's Shelter of Northeast Arkansas and lives in Walnut Ridge.
